description_en: Modifies the SSL link configuration of a cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-db-cluster-ssl --db-cluster-id amv-000000000000 --enable-ssl true --connection-string amv-00000000000.ads.aliyuncs.com --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.description_en:

*   **false**: disabled
